instruction: Scale the image to 640x480 pixels and export it as /home/user/Desktop/resized_white.png.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created a new layer named 'Square' in GIMP by right-clicking the layers panel, selecting New Layer, clearing the default name, typing 'Square', and clicking OK. Completed in 6 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate GIMP layer context menus, open New Layer dialog, edit layer name field, confirm dialog
metadata.task_rationale: Builds on demonstrated GIMP menu navigation by requiring Image > Scale Image dialog interaction plus File > Export As, testing two sequential operations
metadata.explanation: Task requires scaling the 800x800 image to 640x480 and exporting as PNG. Evaluator downloads the exported PNG from VM and checks its dimensions are exactly 640x480.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter vm_file correctly downloads the exported file from /home/user/Desktop/resized_white.png; if the file doesn't exist, src_path is None and the metric returns 0.0, implicitly verifying the export path requirement.

Metric check_image_size correctly receives the rules dict {width: 640, height: 480} and compares actual image dimensions against expected values using exact match, which is appropriate for a pixel-precise scaling task.
Both instruction requirements are covered: (1) scale to 640x480 is verified by dimension check, (2) export to correct path is verified by file existence at that path.
Expected values {width: 640, height: 480} exactly match the instruction requirements.
Postconfig includes a 2-second sleep to allow file export to complete before fetching.
